title: Wave Breaking and Structure-Preserving Fully Discrete Method for Stochastic Camassa--Holm Equation with Additive Noise
summary: In this article, we investigate the stochastic Camassa--Holm equation driven by additive noise, which models nonlinear shallow-water waves under random external forcing. We establish that, almost surely, any finite-time breakdown occurs through wave breaking: the wave amplitude and the positive part of the slope remain bounded, whereas the minimum slope tends to $-\infty$. Under an additional moment assumption, we derive an initial-slope condition ensuring wave breaking with positive probability.
